# P01 · Engine core: errors, items, diagnosis — tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** Pure, fully tested Python for the five error functions, the item generator (collision checks, parallel forms) and diagnosis (2-item rule) that reproduces the printed pilot answer key exactly. Export an answer key plus golden diagnosis cases so the PWA diagnoses on the phone with identical results. Eval 1 proves the error answers and zero collisions.
